examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

включить.gloss: to turn on, to plug in

meanings.en: to switch on, to plug in

examples.trans: I'll plug it in right now.

examples.text: Сейчас включу. Он у нас быстро всё вспомнит.
examples.trans: I'll plug it in right now. He'll remember everything quickly with us.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: Много дел = a lot to do.

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

заставить.gloss: to force, to make (someone do something)

meanings.en: to force, to compel, to make someone do something

examples.trans: The staff forced me into this.

examples.text: Никто не может заставить меня врать.
examples.trans: Nobody can force me to lie.

examples.text: Я своё мнение не менял. Это меня коллектив заставил.
examples.trans: I haven't changed my opinion. The staff forced me into this.

meanings.note: to one person you call ты; здравствуйте is the polite form; the first в is silent

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.trans: And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.
There are brains, but no money.

examples.text: В Москве вам дают деньги на дорогую одежду, а мозги не дают.
examples.trans: In Moscow they give you money for expensive clothes, but they don't give you brains.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

посадить.gloss: to seat; to plant; to put in prison

meanings.en: to put in prison, to lock up
to sit somebody down, to seat

examples.text: Аникеев? Ну что, проворовался? Да я тебя посажу!
examples.trans: Anikeev? Well then, caught stealing? I'll put you in prison!

related.gloss: to sit down; to go to prison

examples.trans: I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
Did you find that little blue bottle?
Did you find the vial? That little blue bottle.
That's a nightmare, I don't argue.

examples.text: Это кошмар, я не спорю. Но зачем на видео снимать?
examples.trans: That's a nightmare, I don't argue. But why film it on video?

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: То есть просто стоять и смотреть?
examples.trans: So we just stand and watch?

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
examples.trans: I told you back then: you'll kiss me one day.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

уступить.gloss: to yield, give in, give way

meanings.en: to yield, give in, give way
meanings.note: уступить место = give up one's seat

examples.text: Он в нужный момент находит силу уступить.
examples.trans: At the right moment he finds the strength to give in.
Make them give way to each other.
The milk is in the fridge.

examples.text: Курица? Нет. А чей это холодильник?
examples.trans: Chicken? No. And whose fridge is this?

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.
